items.t: CrowdStrike CEO: Guardrails alone won't stop uncensored AI cyberattacks
items.sum: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz joins Yahoo Finance's Brian Sozzi to discuss how autonomous AI "agent swarms" are accelerating cyberattacks against critical infrastructure and financial systems, requiring real-time AI defenses to counter them. Kurtz also reflects on his investment in the Mercedes Formula 1 team and praises the rapid maturity of young driver Kimi Antonelli.

items.t: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks Climb 3% as Microsoft Outage Disrupts Outlook and Teams
items.sum: When Microsoft stumbles, some cybersecurity stocks catch a bid. But one leader is still sliding while its rival surges, and an earnings report next week could decide whether this rebound has legs or fades as fast as the outage.
